text: My favorite sport is football. Every Saturday, I play football with my team at the park. Our coach helps us practice before every match. Last week, we had an important match against another school. Many people came to watch. The score was two to one, and our team won! I was very happy because I love to win, but sometimes we also lose, and that is okay too. My sister likes different sports. She plays tennis and basketball. She can run very fast and jump high. My brother likes to swim; he goes to the pool with a ball for water games. My father goes to the gym every morning to do exercise and stay strong. He says exercise is important for a healthy body. In our town, there is also a big running race every year. Many players from other teams come to join. Sport teaches us to work together and try our best, even when we lose.
